title: A quorum queue drops a task that keeps killing its worker at the delivery limit; the state stays PENDING and nothing logs the drop
thread: none needed: documented; a dead letter exchange makes it visible (quorum_dlx_kill passes)
observed: Case kill of that script: RabbitMQ 4.1 quorum queue with x-delivery-limit 1, a task that SIGKILLs its worker's main process and child, a supervisor restarting the worker: 2 runs, 3 worker starts, then nothing on the queue and the state PENDING, 60 s watched.
